threat: A previously valid ExecutionRequest is captured and resent (replayed), either verbatim or after its TTL/expiry has passed.

attacker_capability.note: Assumes attacker can capture a previously valid, signed ExecutionRequest in transit

victim_capability.asset: any capability covered by a captured request

expected_physical_effect: No re-execution of the captured action; audit distinguishes replay-denial reason (duplicate request_id / expired TTL / arg_hash mismatch / capability revoked) from other denial reasons.
limitations: Replay protection here is scoped to requests passing through the DROS-mediated path; see T4 for bypass paths.
request_id uniqueness store persistence across PEP restart is covered separately under T5-03, not assumed here.
